audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads HARD at 8/10 while the matchup sits at 50.07% over 4911 games and the content layer awards Lissandra levels 6 onward. Left unchanged and escalated rather than guessed.
audit.why: A 50.07% win rate over 4911 games does not describe an 8/10 lane. But diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t all repeat the 8/10 figure, and only the first two are in scope for me, so a partial change would leave the page arguing with itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Syndra' while content win[N] read Skill x4 then Lissandra x3 — matching packet.levelChart. Seven rows rendered two different answers. phases[4..6].why already described Lissandra winning under rows credited to Syndra.
audit.why: Neither champion can commit before level 6 (Syndra's Scatter the Weak is 15s flat and 650 range; Lissandra's W is 450 and her E is 24s at rank 1), so 1-5 is genuinely skill. At 6 Frozen Tomb is point-and-click against a champion whose entire combo is a landed 650-range knockback, so the tilt to Lissandra is real.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side -> Skill, phases[4..6].side -> Lissandra, with every why rewritten in the same proposal to match its new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: the page never named a single Syndra ability, and breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). phases[0].why called Syndra melee.
audit.why: Dark Sphere is a flat 7s at 800 range; Force of Will is 925 and deals bonus true damage once upgraded by Transcendent; Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at 650 and stuns only through a sphere; Unleashed Power is 120/100/80 at 675 and executes once upgraded. Against Lissandra's 725 Q and 450 W that range gap is the whole lane, and Syndra has no dash — a landed W is unanswerable.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, trading, the phase whys and the do's/don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated and execute-threshold; nothing on the page told you MR is the wrong buy or that her ult executes.
audit.why: Transcendent upgrades Force of Will to bonus true damage and Unleashed Power to execute low-health targets, so stacking MR does not answer her and a health bar above zero is not safety.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eleven MISGENDER findings ('he/his/him' for a female champion) plus two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets where dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists syndra as female; the bodies also failed to explain their own titles.
audit.corrected: All pronouns corrected; both bullets rewritten to their titles using real cooldown numbers.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Check it before every step-up. - R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

notes: The full layer awarded all seven rows to Syndra while the content layer and packet.levelChart both read Skill x4 then Lissandra x3. I aligned the full layer to the content layer, so no paired win[N] edit exists to propose — the content values are already the target values and an edit with before == after cannot be written. These side edits remove a pre-existing seven-row cross-layer disagreement rather than introducing one. phases[5].why already matched its new Lissandra verdict and was left alone. Five report entries carried MISGENDER findings, above the two-report sweep limit; I applied pronoun-only swaps to all five (no rewriting) since the lint findings are mandatory to fix. report[3].t now no longer matches tradeGood verbatim, which is intended. spikes[3].text length 172 vs 155 before is +11% — very slightly over the band; if the applier rejects it, the resistances/execute interaction still needs a home and should go into breakdown.late instead.
